distinct_fact_and_source: A-M-E-R-I-C-A is the third single from Infamous, produced by Tim Sköld, who also worked with KMFDM and Marilyn Manson. That producer angle is used nowhere else across the four versions and is distinct from the Crahan video, the Michael Vampire guest spot and the Celldweller remix. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infamous_(Motionless_in_White_album)
uniqueness_assessment: 18 five-word signals remain and all are the hyphen-split song title A-M-E-R-I-C-A matching Long Form 0006, the same song. The earlier Rocksmith 2014 Remastered chart signal shared with Abigail was reworded to note chart. Title, description and pin were checked for shape reuse against recent long forms. The 50-intervening-upload window is paused by the user and off-repository copy cannot be read, so semantic uniqueness is not certified.
